        y=arm_center_y,
        width=0.26,
        height=arm_length,
        angle=0.0,
        density=15.0,  # Reduced density for better acceleration
    )
    sandbox.add_joint(arm, None, (pivot_x, pivot_y), type="pivot")
    
    head = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=pivot_x,
        y=pivot_y - arm_length,
        width=0.6,
        height=0.6,
        angle=0.0,
        density=60.0  # Reduced head density for faster swing
    )
    sandbox.add_joint(arm, head, (pivot_x, pivot_y - arm_length), type="rigid")
    
    sandbox.set_material_properties(arm, restitution=0.2)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(head, restitution=0.2)
    
    mass = sandbox.get_structure_mass()
    if mass > sandbox.MAX_STRUCTURE_MASS:
        raise ValueError(f"Structure mass {mass:.2f} kg exceeds limit {sandbox.MAX_STRUCTURE_MASS} kg")
    return head

def agent_action(sandbox, agent_body, step_count):
    # Identify oscillating bar (slot bar)
    bar_body = None
    for body in sandbox.bodies:
        if abs(body.position[0] - 15.0) < 0.1:
            bar_body = body
            break
    
    if bar_body is None:
        return
    
    # Check if bar is in "up" position (angle near 0)
    if abs(bar_body.angle) < 0.1:
        # Apply angular velocity to swing the arm to the right
        arm = sandbox.bodies[0]
        arm.angularVelocity = 25.0  # Higher angular velocity for faster swing
    else:
        # Bar is "down", do nothing
        pass
    
    # Check if head has passed through the slot
    head = sandbox.bodies[1]
    head_pos = head.position
    if head_pos[0] > 15.0 and head_pos[1] > 1.85 and head_pos[1] < 3.35:
        # Continue swinging to hit the shell at x=16.0m
        arm = sandbox.bodies[0]
        arm.angularVelocity = 15.0  # Sustain angular velocity to reach shell

outcome.failure_reason: Shell remained intact at the simulation step limit
